findings.message:
[P2] Emergency retirement can exceed Deno KV atomic mutation limit

`replaceSigningKeyRecord` appends one `delete` per retired key to the same atomic commit that writes the new current key and audit record. On the retained Deno KV adapter (`src/store.ts` selects `Deno.openKv` when no KV service URL is configured), an atomic commit is limited to 10 mutations, so after nine non-expired retired keys this commit exceeds the limit and the emergency retirement fails instead of retiring the suspected key. Batch or cap the deletes, or perform the retirement without an unbounded atomic mutation count.

src/auth_store.ts:1524-1531

[P2] New rotation assertion is not deno-fmt formatted

The new assertion closes the `expect(` call and then puts `.toBe(403)` on a separate line, unlike the analogous existing assertion in this file that uses `).toBe(400);`. `package.json` runs `deno fmt --check ... tests` as part of `bun --no-env-file run check`, so the required check fails. Run the formatter (or attach `.toBe(403);` to the closing parenthesis).

tests/passport_cutover_test.ts:162-165

summary: The signing-key rotation/JWKS overlap and emergency workflows are implemented and covered, but emergency retirement can exceed the Deno KV atomic mutation limit and the new test fails the repository formatter check.

evidence: `src/passport.ts:1414-1472` adds an admin-session-only rotation endpoint, an emergency alias, CSRF and exact-origin checks, request/audit IDs, and recorded actor and origin metadata.

`src/auth_store.ts:1488-1554` atomically writes the new current key, a public-only retired-key record with a bounded TTL for normal rotation, and a signing-key audit record; emergency removes retired keys.

`src/token_service.ts:139-170,185-276` publishes current plus live retired public keys through JWKS, signs only with the current record and retries on rotation, and verifies old tokens only while the retired key is live.
`tests/passport_cutover_test.ts:121-211` and `README.md:96-111` cover normal rotation, JWKS refetch, and emergency replacement, and document the procedure.
